00064 class TextFileWriterInternal : public SmartPointer
00065 {
00066 public:
00067  TextFileWriterInternal(Text const& path) throw();
00068  ~TextFileWriterInternal();
00069  
00070  void write(Text const& text) throw();
00071  void write(const char* text) throw();
00072  void writeValue(const char value) throw();
00073  void writeValue(const int value) throw();
00074  void writeValue(const long value) throw();
00075  void writeValue(const unsigned long value) throw();
00076  void writeValue(const unsigned int value) throw();
00077  void writeValue(const float value) throw();
00078  void writeValue(const double value) throw();
00079  
00080  void writeArray(NumericalArray<char> const& array) throw();
00081  void writeArray(NumericalArray<int> const& array) throw();
00082  void writeArray(NumericalArray<float> const& array) throw();
00083  void writeArray(NumericalArray<double> const& array) throw();
00084  
00085  
00086 private:
00087  void *peer;
00088  
00089  template<class NumericalType>
00090  void writeArrayInternal(NumericalArray<NumericalType> const& array, const char *header = 0) throw()
00091  {
00092   const int arraySize = array.size();
00093   
00094   if(arraySize < 1) return;
00095   
00096   if(header) this->write(header);
00097   
00098   const int size = 128;
00099   char buf[size];
00100   
00101   snprintf(buf, size, "size: %d\n", arraySize);
00102   this->write(buf);
00103   
00104   const NumericalType* arrayPtr = array.getArray();
00105   
00106   for(int i = 0; i < arraySize; i++)
00107   {
00108    snprintf(buf, size, "[%d]=", i);
00109    this->write(buf);
00110    this->writeValue(arrayPtr[i]);
00111    this->write("\n");
00112   }
00113  }
00114 };
